about: The equipment screen's art (docs/art-handoff-equipment.md). Upload each file to art/equipment/<id>.png and run `python3 tools/equipment_art.py check` before uploading.
style: Inked cel illustration for a 2D fantasy game's equipment screen. One clean, uniform, dark outline (#15101f) around every shape, thinner inner lines in the same ink, flat colour fills with exactly three tone steps per material (shadow, mid, light), light from the top left at 45 degrees, no gradients, no texture noise, no cast shadows, no glow, no text, no watermark, no frame, no border.
knight: The same man every time: a human knight-at-arms in his early thirties, athletic and strong but not bulky, about seven heads tall (realistic heroic proportions), warm medium skin (shadow #9c5f48, mid #d08b6a, light #f0b693), dark brown hair pulled back into one braid that hangs behind his head so both ears are fully visible, a short full beard, a calm neutral expression with the eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, no scars, no tattoos, no jewellery, no piercings. He wears only plain undyed linen braies (short drawers ending at mid-thigh; shadow #8f8270, mid #b9ad9b, light #ddd3c4): no armour, no shirt, no shoes, no belt, no weapon.

assets.use: The knight as the equipment screen shows him from the front: the whole-body view, the zoomed regions of the head, torso, arms, waist and legs, the main screen's small figure, and the base every region and slot is mapped on.

The same man every time: a human knight-at-arms in his early thirties, athletic and strong but not bulky, about seven heads tall (realistic heroic proportions), warm medium skin (shadow #9c5f48, mid #d08b6a, light #f0b693), dark brown hair pulled back into one braid that hangs behind his head so both ears are fully visible, a short full beard, a calm neutral expression with the eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, no scars, no tattoos, no jewellery, no piercings. He stands straight, facing the viewer, feet shoulder-width apart and turned very slightly outward, all ten toes visible. His arms hang straight and away from the body at about 25 degrees, so no part of an arm touches the torso or the hips; the hands are open and flat with all five fingers spread apart, and the backs of the hands face the viewer (palms turned backward), every fingernail visible. The anatomy reads clearly as flat shapes: collarbones, pectorals, the breastbone line, the ribs at the sides, the solar plexus, the stomach muscles, the navel, the flanks, hip bones, kneecaps, shins and ankle bones. The canvas is 2160 by 3840 pixels: the figure is centred on the vertical middle line, the top of his hair is 380 px from the top, the soles of his feet are 3600 px from the top, and nothing is cut off. Background: perfectly flat pure green #00ff00 from edge to edge (or real transparency), with no floor, no ground shadow and nothing else on it.

assets.prompt: Painted background for a 2D fantasy game's equipment screen: the inside of a dim armourer's fitting room at night, seen straight on. Stone walls, a tall arched window with cold moonlight on the far left, armour stands and racks of weapons and banners as soft shapes far back at the sides, warm candlelight from the top left. Painterly and soft-edged, desaturated (saturation at most 35%), dark (values between 5% and 40%), low contrast, with a calm, almost empty darker middle where a figure will stand in front of it, and a soft vignette. No people, no figure, no mannequin in the middle, no text, no frame. 2560 by 1920 pixels.

assets.use: Behind a piece and its own slots (a helm with its crest, visor and gem sockets).
assets.prompt: Painted background seen from directly above: an armourer's workbench, a dark worn leather work mat filling the middle, a few tools (pliers, a small hammer, a jeweller's loupe, rivets, a whetstone) and scraps of leather only at the edges, warm lamplight from the top left. Painterly and soft-edged, desaturated (saturation at most 35%), dark (values between 5% and 40%), low contrast, the middle empty and calm because a piece and its slots are drawn on top of it. No text, no frame. 2560 by 1920 pixels.

assets.use: One glyph for each kind of slot, drawn inside the slot markers on the figure (tinted by code).
assets.prompt: A sheet of ten simple, bold game interface glyphs, solid white silhouettes with no outline, no shading and no colour, each centred in its own cell of an invisible grid of five columns and two rows, each filling about 60% of its cell and never touching another, readable when shrunk to 16 pixels. In reading order: 1. a drop of ink with a small swirl inside (ink on the skin: tattoos, sigils, kohl); 2. a quilted padded square with stitched diamond lines (cloth worn under: shirts, gloves, socks); 3. four interlinked rings of chain mail; 4. a curved plate of armour with two rivets (plate armour); 5. a hanging cloak with a clasp at the top (worn over everything: cloaks, tabards, hoods); 6. a finger ring with a cut gemstone (jewellery); 7. a sword, point up, slightly diagonal (held: weapons, shields, an orb); 8. a curved horn (grown from the body: horns, wings, a tail, gills); 9. a four-pointed star inside a thin orbit ring (around the body: aura, orbiting stones, the heavens); 10. a round socket holding a small gem, with three prongs (a piece's own slot: gems, runes, fittings). Background: perfectly flat pure green #00ff00 from edge to edge (or real transparency), with no floor, no ground shadow and nothing else on it. 2560 by 1024 pixels.
